learning_objective: 🎯 To feel immense pride in our Armed Forces and understand the deep gratitude we owe to the brave soldiers who protect our great nation!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The National War Memorial in New Delhi is not just a regular park. It is a very sacred and special place built to honor the absolute bravest heroes of India.
At the center of the memorial burns a continuous, bright flame. This fire never goes out, just like our memory and respect for the soldiers will never fade away.
The names of thousands of courageous soldiers who gave up their lives for our safety are carved on the walls. Every single name tells a story of supreme bravery.
Visiting the memorial makes us feel proud and thankful. It teaches us that our peaceful lives today are a precious gift from those who fought for our tomorrow.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 A Letter to a Hero!
fun_activity.instructions: Write a short, heartfelt 'Thank You' note to an unknown soldier serving at the borders, telling them how much you appreciate their hard work and bravery.

quick_recap: ⭐ The National War Memorial is a majestic tribute to India's brave soldiers.
⭐ It features an eternal flame that symbolizes the immortal spirit of the martyrs.
⭐ The names of fallen heroes are forever etched into the beautiful stone walls.
⭐ We must always remember, respect, and show deep gratitude for their sacrifices.
